candidate.what: encoder-only fine-tune on FLEURS fr_fr punctuated train (1,440 utterances), 180 steps, seed 20261117: the R3 24-step smoke at full length

declared_outcome_before_running: support cannot be met: 20 pooled speaker groups < 30, so the review ends insufficient_support (exit 4) and the result is an observation whatever the WER. The pilot measures whether 180 steps keep G1-G3 and move WER/CER; it cannot promote. Promotion needs an owner-approved evaluation source adding at least 10 speaker groups disjoint from training.

held_out.decoding: flh_speaking_transcribe_v1 in one image, same batch size
held_out.name: flh_speaking_heldout_r4_v1

slices.use: diagnostic only: same corpus as training, no speaker IDs

limits: single seed; FLEURS train speakers unknown; same author designs and evaluates
status: registered before any R4 training run (none has run; the job needs the owner's approval)
stopping_rule: one job; it ends at 180 steps, MaxRuntimeInSeconds 3600, MaxWaitTimeInSeconds 7200 or an owner stop; one evaluation of base and candidate on the held-out slices; no re-run with changed thresholds, data or seed under this id
task: French speech recognition (transcription for FLH's Speaking feature)

objective.G1: punctuated share >= 0.8 x base on mls_test and fleurs_ood
objective.G2: MLS test served-WER difference 95% upper bound <= +1.0 pt
